title: Verify your email
purpose: Follow the email sent to confirm ownership of an address.
summary: A verification link was sent to your address. Follow it from your mailbox to confirm that the address is yours.

tasks.title: Verify the address
steps: Open the email and follow its verification link. Check your spam folder if it has not arrived.
On the link's page, select Confirm.

tasks.title: Ask for another link
steps: On the Email addresses page, select the address and choose Re-send Verification.

good_to_know: Asking for a link does not verify the address. Only confirming the link does.
The text mentions sign-up, but accounts here are issued by the laboratory. This page also confirms addresses on existing accounts.
Whether the email arrives depends on the deployment's outgoing mail.

sections.title: State and next step
paragraphs: Verify Your Email Address has no editable fields or resend action. Follow the verification link in the mailbox and check spam if needed. The stock text mentions signup, but public sign-up is closed here; this screen also serves existing-account verification. Delivery depends on the deployment’s outgoing-mail configuration. A message being requested does not make an address verified. Return to Email Addresses to request another link when needed.
